name: dobe_push5_lean
desc: pink goo doberman hugging someone tightly is pushed away and leans only its upper body far backward toward the viewer, its right hand never lets go and keeps gripping the pillar edge so the arm stretches taut, its lower body and drips stay still stuck to the goo pillar, thick ropes of sticky goo stretch and sag, head drops back with a calm closed-eye faint smirk, smooth motion
